competence_summary: Assesses team member availability, skills matrix affinities, vacation schedules, and workload utilization to balance tasks across sprints and PI increments without burnout.
reasoning_heuristics: Step 1: Retrieve engineer allocation roster and planned hours from BigQuery resources table.
Step 2: Query Qdrant for semantic match between task technical requirements and engineer competencies.
Step 3: Factor in planned leaves, holidays, and on-call rotations to compute net available capacity.
Step 4: Flag any engineer allocated beyond the 85% safety threshold.
Step 5: Formulate workload rebalancing recommendations (e.g. shift non-critical tasks to subsequent sprints or peer developers).

candidate_agents.delegation_goal: Retrieve developer capacity envelopes, competencies, and current assignments.

input_guardrails: Sprint or PI timeframe must be specified.
Valid engineer or squad identifier required.
safety_guardrails: PM.ai must NOT reassign engineers without validating requisite technical competency.
PM.ai must respect maximum 40h/week baseline without explicit executive overtime authorization.

pass_conditions: Capacity envelope calculated per team member.
Rebalancing plan proposed with zero unassigned high-priority tasks.

visual_first_specification.visual_generation_prompt: A modern clean corporate capacity chart showing individual team members along the X-axis and weekly hours on Y-axis. Over-allocated members are highlighted in vivid red with an 85% horizontal dotted threshold line.
visual_first_specification.fallback_mermaid:
graph LR
  E1[Dev Alpha: 95% - Overallocated] --> REBALANCE[Rebalance to Dev Beta]
  E2[Dev Beta: 65% - Available]
  style E1 fill:#ffcccc,stroke:#cc0000,stroke-width:2px
  style E2 fill:#ccffcc,stroke:#00aa00,stroke-width:2px
